verses.text: Ha winhaj Darío yuninal winhaj Asuero yinhtilal heb' medo, ix och winh reyal t'a smakb'en heb' caldeo. Ha t'a b'ab'el ab'il yoch winh t'a yajalil chi', a in Daniel in tik, wan in k'ayb'an juntzanh ch'anh libro b'aj lolonnak Jehová t'a winhaj Jeremías, haton winh schekab'. Yuj chi' ix nachajel wu'uj to a Jerusalén, 70 ab'il ol kan tzinan.
Yuj chi' ix in lesalwi, ix in tewi t'a Dios Kajal. Ix in ochpax t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Ix wak'anoch pichul yik tzek'ojk'olal chi', ix in em k'ojan t'a skal k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh.

Ix in lesalwi t'a Jehová in Diosal, ix walan in b'a t'ay icha tik: Mamin, Wajal ach, te niwan elk'ochi, te satub'tak yilji a poder. Tzak'elk'och a trato yik tzak'an a wach'k'olal t'a heb' tzach xajanani, haton heb' sk'anab'ajan a cheknab'il.
Ix och ko chukal yet' ko pital t'ayach. Haxonhej chukal ix ko k'ulej. Ix ko patikejkanel a cheknab'il yet' a k'ayb'ub'al.
Maj ko maklej kab' tas ix yal heb' a chekab'. Yalnak a lolonel heb' t'a heb' ko reyal, t'a heb' yajal yaj t'a ko kal, t'a heb' ko mam kicham yet' t'a masanil heb' ketchonhab'.

Ach Mamin Kajal, te tojol a pensar, xal onh israel onh tik, k'ixwelaltak kajek' skab'i. Ha heb' kotnak t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén yet' juntzanhxo heb' ketisraelal kajan t'a najat yet' t'a lak'an, ix onh a saklemejkanb'ati, yujto manh k'anab'ajumok ix kutej ko b'a t'ayach.
Ha onh tik Mamin Jehová, k'ixawtak ko k'o'ol t'a ichanh, yujto ix och ko mul t'ayach yet' pax heb' ko reyal, heb' yajal yaj t'a ko kal yet' pax heb' ko mam kicham.
Palta a ach tik Mamin, ko Diosal ach, te ay ok'elk'olal yet' a niwank'olal, wach'chom a onh tik haxonhej pitalil sko k'ulej t'a ichanh.
Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, maj ach ko k'anab'ajej icha ix aj a chekan yal heb' a chekab' t'ayonh.

Ha onh tik, ko masanil ix ko tenek' a cheknab'il, ix ach ko patikejeli, manhxalaj ko gana ix kab' tas ix ala'. Yuj ko mul chi', ix jawi masanil juntzanh ya'elal t'a kib'anh, haton tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a yol ch'anh libro stz'ib'ejnakkan winh a chekab' aj Moisés.
Toxo ix elk'och tas ix ala' to ol jawok t'a kib'anh a onh tik yet' t'a heb' kajalil. Te niwan ix aj ak'an sya'elal Jerusalén t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab'.

Masanil juntzanh ya'elal tz'ib' yajkan t'a ch'anh libro yuj winhaj Moisés, ix jawi t'a kib'anh tiknaik. Palta anhej t'a spatik chukal ix onh b'atkani, majxo ko k'anab'ajej a lolonel yik tzak' a wach'k'olal t'ayonh.
Yuj wal chi' Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, ix a na' ak'kot jun niwan ya'elal tik t'a kib'anh. Ha ach tik, tojol ach t'a masanil tas tza k'ulej, a onhxo tik, maj ko b'alaj chaej kab' t'ayach.

Ach ko Diosal Kajal ach, a ch'oxnak wal a niwan poder ayik ik'annakelta heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto. Yuj chi' te b'inajnak ach masanto tiknaik, palta a onh tik jun, ix och ko mul, anhej chukal sko k'ulej.

Mamin Kajal, kojtak to tza k'ulejnhej tas tzala'. Yuj chi' elok wal t'a a k'ol ik'anel ya'elal yet' yowal a k'ol ayoch t'a yib'anh chonhab' Jerusalén, yujto a chonhab' yaji, ikpax yaj tzalan Sion. Masanil nación ay t'a slak'anil sb'uchwaj heb' t'a a chonhab' chi', yujnhej ko chukal yet' yuj schukal heb' ko mam kicham.
Ach ko Diosal, ab' wal in lesal yet' b'aj tzin tewi a in a chekab' in tik. Yuj wal a b'inaji, ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh a templo tzinan yajkani.
Cha ab' Mamin, ilnab' wal tas yaji, tzinan yajkan jun a chonhab' sb'inaj to ik yaji. Manh yujok ko wach'il t'a yol kiko' tzonh tewi t'ayach, palta a wal yuj a niwan wach'k'olal.

Mamin Kajalil, tak'wej onh, ak' lajwok ko chukal. Kotanh, kolwajanh ket'ok. Yuj wal a b'inajnakil, mokab' ek' tiempo onh a kolani, yujto ojtakab'il to ik onh yet' a chonhab' Jerusalén, xin chi t'a in lesal chi'.
Yakb'an wannhej in lesalwi, wan walank'eta in mul yet' smul heb' wetchonhab' israel, tzin tewioch t'a Jehová in Diosal yuj tzalan Sion yiknhej yaji.
Yakb'an wan in lesalwi chi', haxo ángel Gabriel, jun sch'oxnak sb'a t'ayin t'a yalanhtaxo, ix jawi jenhenhok b'aj ayinek' chi', ichawal yorail yik tz'ak'ji silab' t'a Jehová t'a yemk'ualil.
Ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Daniel, tzin jawi t'ayach yik tzul wak'an a jelanil yik snachajel u'uj tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb' etchonhab'.

Ayik ix a yamanoch a lesalwi, ha Dios ix pakan a lesal chi', yuj chi' tzin jawi ul wal t'ayach, yujto te xajan ach yuj Dios. Ha tiknaik, maklej ab' tas ol wal t'ayach yik ol nachajel u'uj tas ol ak'jok il tik.

Ol ek' 70 semana t'a yib'anh heb' etisraelal yet' t'a yib'anh a chonhab' to yiknhej Dios yaji, masanto yik ol lajwokek' pitalil yet' chukal, haxo yak'ji tup masanil mul, hata', tojolnhej ol aj t'a smasanil tiempo. Ol elk'och masanil tas ix ch'oxji yil heb' schekab' Dios yet' tas alb'ilkan yuj heb'. Ol ak'chajoch jun lugar yiknhej Dios yaj t'a yopisio.

Yowalil ol nachajel jun tik u'uj: Ayik ol alchajok to ol b'ochajxik'e chonhab' Jerusalén, ol ek' uke' semana b'ab'el, slajwi chi' ol ek' pax 62 semana. Ichato chi' ol ja jun Yajal to sik'b'ileli. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ol b'ochajxik'e scalleal yet' smuroal Jerusalén chi' t'a skal jantak ya'elal.

Ayik toxo ix lajwiek' 62 semana chi', ol miljokcham jun Yajal sik'b'ilel chi', ichato malaj tas syik'a'. Slajwi chi' ol juchajem templo yet' chonhab' Jerusalén yuj heb' anima ayoch yet' jun yajal ol jawok. Icha wal yel ha' eluma', icha chi' ol aj slajwiel Jerusalén chi'. Ha tas nab'il yuj Dios, ol ochnhej owal yet' somchajb'ail masanto t'a slajwub' k'ual.

Ha jun yajal ol jawok chi', tzijtum heb' anima ol yak' pural yik sb'o'an strato yet'ok t'a junok semana, palta t'a wal snanhalb'i jun semana chi', haxo skachanoch wa'an yak'chaj silab' yet' ofrenda t'a Dios. Haxo jun yajal chuk chi', ol yak'och tas to yajb'il yuj Dios t'a yol templo. Aynhejek' ta', masanto ol yak'kot Dios tas nab'il yuj t'a yib'anh jun yajal chuk chi', xchi ángel Gabriel chi' t'ayin.
